sylvia: Sylvia spent several years as a Regnan Pirate, until she decided that a pirate's life was not for her. She sought a new beginning in Erathia's military and now serves in the Coastal Patrol. There she fights raids by the very Pirates with whom she once sailed.
lordHaart: Some say Lord Haart left Enroth because of ties to a Necromantic cult. His service to Erathia's crown, like his service to Roland Ironfist before the Succession Wars, has been spotless—a stark contrast to the rumor.
christian: Christian was a frontiersman long before he settled into Erathian military service, having set foot in nearly every part of Enroth. A wanderer and something of a dreamer, he is far from the conventional Knight. His battlefield tactics, however, are feared throughout the world.
cuthbert: Cuthbert once toyed with darker magics as a young man. When a spell he cast went awry and killed his wife, he turned to good and never looked back. His past did not erase what he learned: Cuthbert's insight into the workings of dark magic gives him an edge possessed by no other.
adelaide: A storm caught Adelaide at sea, wrecking her ship on Vori, home of the Snow Elves. She trained with them for some twenty years. Upon returning to Erathia, she discovered that no time had passed in her absence.
